evidence.title: Agent Elements - Build agent UIs faster

name: Agent Elements
summary: Open-source shadcn registry of 25 React components for agent UIs: chat shell, tool call cards, streaming markdown, input controls.
description: Chat and agent UI components built on shadcn/ui, installed per component with the shadcn CLI into components/agent-elements: AgentChat, MessageList, InputBar with Suggestions, ModelPicker and ModeSelector, streaming markdown with Shiki highlighting, attachment and send buttons, streaming states (ThinkingTool, TextShimmer, SpiralLoader) and tool cards for Bash, Edit, Search, Todo, Plan, Subagent, MCP and clarifying questions. Typed around the Vercel AI SDK, so useChat plugs in directly. An MCP setup and an agent skill ship alongside; the set is the UI layer of the 21st.dev Agent SDK.
contains: 25 components grouped by role: chat surface, tool cards, streaming states
chat surface: AgentChat, MessageList, UserMessage, InputBar, Suggestions, ModelPicker, ModeSelector
tool cards: BashTool, EditTool, SearchTool, TodoTool, PlanTool, ToolGroup, SubagentTool, McpTool, QuestionTool
streaming: ThinkingTool, TextShimmer, SpiralLoader; streaming markdown with Shiki highlighting
installs per component with npx shadcn@latest add from the registry (or agent-chat for the full set)
built on React 19, Tailwind v4 and the Vercel AI SDK (UIMessage / ChatStatus)
MCP server support and an agent skill for Claude Code and Cursor
UI layer of the 21st.dev Agent SDK
